name: Cushi
bio: Cushi was the messenger Joab sent to tell David the outcome of the battle against Absalom's forces, after refusing to let Ahimaaz carry news that would include word of Absalom's death. Ahimaaz insisted on running too and outran Cushi, reaching David first with a report of victory but claiming not to know Absalom's fate; moments later Cushi arrived and delivered the news more fully, telling David that the enemies who rose against him had met the same end as the young man Absalom — prompting David's famous lament, "O my son Absalom! My son, my son Absalom! If only I had died instead of you" (2 Samuel 18:19-33).
